text: summary stock dataset calculated FLStock object. spawning stock biomass, mean fishing mortality recruitment come model estimates. catches SAG usually observed catches, catches come observed data dataset , estimates otherwise. SAG catches year, landings discards added together used instead, landings alone discards. Recruitment thousands .
code: # The summary of a stock assessment in the dataset. # # Returns a data frame with one row per quantity and year.  dataset_summary <- function(stock_code, assessment_year) {   estimated <- stockpile_flstock(stock_code, assessment_year, type = "estimated")   version <- stockpile_stocks(stock_code, assessment_year)   catches <- if (version$observed) {     catch(stockpile_flstock(stock_code, assessment_year, type = "observed"))   } else {     catch(estimated)   }    quantities <- list(SSB = ssb(estimated), F = fbar(estimated), recruitment = rec(estimated), catches = catches)   rows <- lapply(names(quantities), function(quantity) {     values <- as.data.frame(quantities[[quantity]])     data.frame(quantity = quantity, year = values$year, dataset = values$data)   })   do.call(rbind, rows) }  # The summary of a stock assessment in SAG, in the same layout.  sag_summary <- function(stock_code, assessment_year) {   sag <- getSAG(stock_code, assessment_year)   # SAG can have more than one assessment of a stock in a year   sag <- sag[sag$AssessmentKey == stockpile_stocks(stock_code, assessment_year)$assessment_key, ]    # where SAG has no catches, the landings and discards are used, or the   # landings alone if there are no discards   sag$catches <- ifelse(     !is.na(sag$catches), sag$catches,     ifelse(!is.na(sag$discards), sag$landings + sag$discards, sag$landings)   )    rows <- lapply(c("SSB", "F", "recruitment", "catches"), function(quantity) {     data.frame(quantity = quantity, year = sag$Year, sag = sag[[quantity]])   })   do.call(rbind, rows) }  # Is a value in the dataset the same as the value in SAG? # # It is if the two are within 2.5% of each other, or within the rounding of # SAG: half a unit in the last decimal place that SAG holds for the quantity.  same_as_sag <- function(dataset, sag) {   places <- 0   while (places < 6 && any(abs(sag - round(sag, places)) > 1e-9)) places <- places + 1   abs(dataset / sag - 1) < 0.025 | abs(dataset - sag) <= 0.5 * 10^-places }  # The two summaries side by side, for the years and quantities in both.  compare_summaries <- function(stock_code, assessment_year) {   both <- merge(dataset_summary(stock_code, assessment_year), sag_summary(stock_code, assessment_year))   both <- both[!is.na(both$dataset) & !is.na(both$sag) & both$sag != 0, ]   both$ratio <- both$dataset / both$sag   both <- both[order(both$quantity, both$year), ]   # SAG holds each quantity to its own number of decimal places   both$same <- as.logical(ave(seq_len(nrow(both)), both$quantity, FUN = function(rows) {     same_as_sag(both$dataset[rows], both$sag[rows])   }))   both }

code: stocks <- stockpile_stocks() stocks <- stocks[stocks$estimated, ] stocks$simple <- stocks$n_seasons == 1 & stocks$n_units == 1 & stocks$n_areas == 1  comparisons <- lapply(which(stocks$simple), function(i) {   compared <- try(compare_summaries(stocks$stock_code[i], stocks$assessment_year[i]), silent = TRUE)   if (inherits(compared, "try-error") || nrow(compared) == 0) {     return(NULL)   }   cbind(stock_code = stocks$stock_code[i], assessment_year = stocks$assessment_year[i], compared) }) comparisons <- do.call(rbind, comparisons)  stocks$compared <- paste(stocks$stock_code, stocks$assessment_year) %in%   paste(comparisons$stock_code, comparisons$assessment_year) agreement <- aggregate(same ~ stock_code + assessment_year + quantity, comparisons, all)  table(agreement$quantity, ifelse(agreement$same, "same", "different")) #>               #>               different same #>   catches            21   14 #>   F                   6   30 #>   recruitment         5   29 #>   SSB                 5   31 all_same <- aggregate(same ~ stock_code + assessment_year, agreement, all)

code: stocks <- stockpile_stocks()  stock_database <- lapply(unique(stocks$assessment_year), function(year) {   sd <- getSD(year = year)   data.frame(     stock_code = sd$StockKeyLabel,     assessment_year = year,     expert_group = sd$ExpertGroup,     data_category = sd$DataCategory,     species = sd$SpeciesCommonName   ) }) stock_database <- do.call(rbind, stock_database)  # the expert group of each stock assessment is in the dataset stocks <- merge(stocks, stock_database[c("stock_code", "assessment_year", "data_category", "species")], all.x = TRUE)  # what the dataset has for each stock assessment, or that it is from SAG stocks$contents <- ifelse(   stocks$origin == "SAG", "from SAG",   ifelse(     stocks$observed & stocks$estimated, "observed and estimated",     ifelse(stocks$estimated, "estimated only", "observed only")   ) ) stocks$contents <- factor(stocks$contents, c("observed and estimated", "estimated only", "observed only", "from SAG"))  # a label for each stock assessment stocks$assessment <- paste0(stocks$stock_code, " (", stocks$assessment_year, ")")  contents_colours <- c(   "observed and estimated" = "#1b9e77", "estimated only" = "#7570b3", "observed only" = "#d95f02", "from SAG" = "#e6ab02" ) latest_year <- max(stocks$assessment_year) active <- stock_database[stock_database$assessment_year == latest_year, ] active$data_category <- floor(as.numeric(active$data_category))  # what the dataset has for each stock in the latest year, if anything active <- merge(active, stocks[stocks$assessment_year == latest_year, c("stock_code", "contents")], all.x = TRUE) active$in_dataset <- !is.na(active$contents) active$status <- factor(   ifelse(active$in_dataset, as.character(active$contents), "not submitted"),   c(levels(stocks$contents), "not submitted") )  # only the expert groups with stocks in the dataset, most first submitted <- tapply(active$in_dataset, active$expert_group, sum) active <- active[active$expert_group %in% names(submitted)[submitted > 0], ] active$expert_group <- factor(active$expert_group, names(sort(submitted[submitted > 0], decreasing = TRUE))) ggplot(active, aes(y = factor(data_category), fill = status)) +   geom_bar(position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE)) +   facet_grid(expert_group ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y", switch = "y") +   scale_x_continuous(breaks = function(limits) seq(0, limits[2], by = 2)) +   scale_y_discrete(limits = rev) +   scale_fill_manual(values = c(contents_colours, "not submitted" = "grey85")) +   labs(title = "Submission status: stock coverage", x = paste("stocks in", latest_year), y = "data category", fill = NULL) +   theme_minimal() +   theme(     legend.position = "bottom",     plot.title.position = "plot",     strip.placement = "outside",     strip.text.y.left = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 1),     panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),     panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),     panel.spacing = unit(0.6, "lines")   )

", paste0("", text, "", collapse = " "), "

") } # The dots for a stock: which slots have values, observed and estimated. dots_plot <- function(stock) { values <- stockpile_values(stock$stock_code, stock$assessment_year) present <- expand.grid(slot = c(slots, "survey index"), type = names(colours)) present$found <- paste(present$slot, present$type) %in% c(paste(values$slot, values$type), paste(values$slot[values$type == "both"], rep(names(colours), each = sum(values$type == "both")))) present$found[present$slot == "survey index"] <- c(stock$indices > 0, FALSE) present$slot <- factor(present$slot, c(slots, "survey index")) present$type <- factor(present$type, rev(names(colours))) ggplot(present, aes(slot, type)) + geom_point(data = present[!present$found, ], shape = 1, size = 2.2, colour = "grey80") + geom_point(aes(colour = type), data = present[present$found, ], size = 3) + # the two parts of a slot name go on two lines, to fit scale_x_discrete(position = "top", drop = FALSE, labels = function(slot) gsub("[. ]", "\n", slot)) + scale_y_discrete(drop = FALSE) + scale_colour_manual(values = colours, guide = "none") + labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) + theme_minimal(base_size = 9) + theme( panel.grid = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_text(colour = "grey40"), axis.text.y = element_text(colour = "grey20") ) } # The plots for a stock: the four quantities in the dataset and in SAG. check_plot <- function(check, agreed) { # the observed lines are drawn first, so the estimates are on top lines <- attr(check, "lines") lines <- lines[order(lines$type != "observed"), ] lines$type <- factor(lines$type, names(colours)) # every quantity gets a panel, with or without values panels <- data.frame(quantity = factor(quantities, quantities), year = min(check$year), value = 0) plot <- ggplot(check, aes(year)) + geom_blank(aes(y = value), data = panels) if (any(agreed$status == "different")) { plot <- plot + geom_rect( data = agreed[agreed$status == "different", ], inherit.aes = FALSE, xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = "#e9695f", alpha = 0.12 ) } plot + geom_line(aes(y = dataset, colour = type), data = lines, linewidth = 0.7) + scale_colour_manual(values = colours, guide = "none") + geom_point(aes(y = sag), data = check[!is.na(check$sag), ], colour = "grey25", size = 0.7) + facet_wrap(~quantity, nrow = 1, scales = "free_y", drop = FALSE) + scale_y_continuous(labels = function(y) format(y, big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE)) + labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) + theme_minimal(base_size = 9) + theme( panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), strip.text = element_text(hjust = 0, face = "bold") ) }

title: Access the ICES Stockpile of Stock Assessment Results
text: Say dataset . latest data release: release change address tag, example .../releases/download/v2026.002. List stock assessments. one stock code assessment year, default latest version returned: Get values stock, total catch last two years. observed catch catch estimated model stored: Get estimates FLStock, needs FLCore (install.packages("FLCore", repos = "https://flr.r-universe.dev")): observed data stockpile_flstock("sol.27.7d", type = "observed").
code: library(flstockpile)  options(flstockpile.url = "https://github.com/ices-tools-prod/flstockpile/releases/latest/download") stocks <- stockpile_stocks() nrow(stocks) #> [1] 47 head(stocks[c("stock_code", "assessment_year", "version", "case_id", "observed", "estimated")]) #>      stock_code assessment_year version          case_id observed estimated #> 1  ank.27.78abd            2026       1 CAS-88100-V7W8S9    FALSE      TRUE #> 2   ank.27.8c9a            2026       1 CAS-88489-K0L3G2    FALSE      TRUE #> 3 bll.27.3a47de            2026       1 CAS-87856-K4Q1M7    FALSE      TRUE #> 4     caa.27.5a            2026       1 CAS-88823-L1B9G4    FALSE      TRUE #> 5  cod.21.1.isc            2026       1 CAS-88393-C4D5T8     TRUE     FALSE #> 6  cod.21.1.osc            2026       1 CAS-88389-H4P0R9     TRUE     FALSE catch <- stockpile_values("sol.27.7d", slot = "catch") catch <- catch[catch$year >= 2024, c("stock_code", "slot", "type", "year", "value")] catch[order(catch$year, catch$type), ] #>    stock_code  slot      type year    value #> 87  sol.27.7d catch estimated 2024 1374.940 #> 43  sol.27.7d catch  observed 2024 1574.047 #> 88  sol.27.7d catch estimated 2025 1276.954 #> 44  sol.27.7d catch  observed 2025 1251.492 library(FLCore)  stock <- stockpile_flstock("sol.27.7d") summary(stock) #> An object of class "FLStock" #>  #> Name:   #> Description: FLStock created from SAM model fit  #> Quant: age  #> Dims:  age   year    unit    season  area    iter #>  11  44  1   1   1   1    #>  #> Range:  min  max pgroup  minyear maxyear minfbar maxfbar  #>  1   11  11  1982    2025    3   7    #>  #> Metrics:  #>   rec: 9491 - 49819  (1000)  #>   ssb: 8875 - 18668  (t)  #>   catch: 1277 - 6416  (NA)  #>   fbar: 0.20 - 0.53  (f)

title: Access the ICES Stockpile of Stock Assessment Results

code: stockpile_stocks("meg.27.7b-k8abd", version = "all")[c("stock_code", "version", "latest", "submitted", "n_iters")] #>        stock_code version latest           submitted n_iters #> 1 meg.27.7b-k8abd       1  FALSE 2026-05-11 09:43:38       1 #> 2 meg.27.7b-k8abd       2  FALSE 2026-05-11 10:31:59       1 #> 3 meg.27.7b-k8abd       3   TRUE 2026-10-04 13:56:04    1000 stockpile_stocks("meg.27.7b-k8abd", as_of = "2026-06-01")[c("stock_code", "version", "submitted")] #>        stock_code version           submitted #> 1 meg.27.7b-k8abd       2 2026-05-11 10:31:59

title: flstockpile 0.1.0
text: First version: stockpile_stocks(), stockpile_sources(), stockpile_values() stockpile_indices() read dataset tables, stockpile_flstock() converts values one stock FLStock. package renamed FLStockpile flstockpile, match repository, moved ices-tools-prod/flstockpile. option sets dataset location now flstockpile.url. Stocks FLStock submitted, data category 5, can taken catches, landings discards published SAG. new origin column stockpile_stocks() stockpile_sources() "SAG" , stockpile_flstock() returns FLStock ages.
